parts: Breakfast over, my uncle drew from his pocket a small notebook, intended for scientific observations. He consulted his instruments, and recorded: “Monday, July 1. “Chronometer,
; barometer, 297 in.; thermometer, 6 (43 F.). Direction, E. S. E.” This last observation applied to the dark gallery, and was indicated by the compass.
title: A Journey to the Centre of the Earth
author: Jules Verne
